title: Fix CAD JS Model Definition Catalog Fixture Bugs
description: Fix pre-existing cad-js model-definition catalog/fixture bugs, transformation spec loading, brepjs STEP export/import/fixture issues, and extension test failures.
summary: Fixed catalog asset path markers in modelDefinitionAssetPathRest and shippedModelDefinitionAssets, resolved transformation spec loading, fixed STEP fixture paths in brepjs component.ts, added fallback handling in deriveValidSolidFromRecordOrPrimitive and exportModelSpaceToStep, and updated @semio-tech/kernel-3d-js package.json exports.
